cover.title: Example: turn on email alerts
cover.subtitle: Find the setting and see where to switch it on

steps.say: Start on the home page and open Settings in the left-hand menu.
steps.why: Every admin option lives under Settings.

steps.say: Settings opens on the General tab. Select the Notifications tab.
steps.why: Alert options are grouped on their own tab.

steps.say: Turn on Email alerts, then select Save to keep the change.
steps.why: This is the switch that turns email alerts on.

end.title: All done
end.text: You know where email alerts live in Acme Admin. Make your own demo next: see the README.
